build_dataset_train: build a training dataset from a config dict with type, data_prefix, and test_mode set to False
build_dataset_test: build a test dataset from a config dict with type, data_prefix, and test_mode set to True
build_dataset_MNIST: build an MNIST dataset using build_dataset with a config specifying MNIST type and data path
review_build_dataset: review the build_dataset function that delegates to the DATASETS registry to construct datasets from config
summarize_build_dataset: summarize the build_dataset function which takes a config dict and returns a built dataset instance
